note: Pinned revisions of the sibling repositories sb3-creator's cross-repo gates consume. CI checks these exact commits out beside the repo (.github/workflows/ci.yml) so the gates RUN rather than skip; test/helpers/siblings.mjs turns an absent sibling into a failure when CI=true. Update a pin deliberately, in its own commit, with the suite green against it. `rev` MUST be the FULL 40-character SHA: actions/checkout only recognises a full SHA as a commit, and turns anything shorter into `git fetch origin +refs/heads/<ref>*` — a branch glob that matches nothing. An abbreviated pin here took every CI run on main down at the checkout step, before lint, tests, the mutation prover or the build ran at all. gate-integrity asserts the length; `revShort` exists only for prose.

bw-board.why: the device/board simulator the gallery e2e and physics gates drive. Advanced from 6571648 to 338ac5d, and the bump is FORCED by this repo's own ratchet rather than routine: bench-invariants carried two open 'invented terminal' endpoints, both mcu1.P4.7 in 60-retro-console's STC12 variants, because bw-circuit-ui's generic mcu catalog names PDIP-40 pin 9 RST and the bench wires P4.7. MEASURED through the engine before choosing anything, a fresh board per drive: setPin('P4.7') moves the buzzer PNP's base net (r1.a 4.990020 idle -> 0.103865 low -> 5.000000 high, collector 0 -> 4.795205), setPin('RST') was bit-identical to a nonexistent-terminal control at 4.990020 on every mode. So the engine modelled that pin as a GPIO under one spelling only, and the 8051 adapter emits P${port}.${bit} — P4.7 is the name a write to P4^7 arrives under. 3160a10 declares pin 9's two datasheet names as ONE pin with a unique-match rule (the alias fires only when the part declares exactly one of the pair, so it can never merge terminals a netlist kept apart; the declared spelling always outranks the alias) and routes every electrical MCU-terminal lookup through one helper — the MNA path, both closed-form source traces, and the two DRC checks — with a hand oracle (5*25/1025 = 0.1219512195121951) and three mutations. 338ac5d exports that table so bench-invariants can ASK the engine which two names are one pin instead of re-declaring the pair. Corpus census at the previous pair: 2163 circuit files, exactly three kind-'mcu' parts name either spelling and ZERO name both, so the ambiguous case does not occur and nothing previously driven is driven differently. The range also carries other lanes' landed work — 1987d6d (74C922 physical keypad matrix), b6df775 (the E4.1 hazard oracle), e537bd7+9b2fc40+5f79057 (open drain on both tiers, corpus impact counted as zero: OTYPER is absent from the codegen vocabulary), and 3f47825 (the double-entry repair and the tightened band) — all validated against this corpus at this pin before the bump.

bw-circuit-ui.why: the canonical circuit model, engine, and the ONE wire-endpoint dialect reader the corpus gates read circuit.json through. BUMPED 2026-09-08 from 14efc75 to master's tip c276c0d, and the bump is FORCED by parts-data that landed upstream AFTER the previous pin: src/parts-data/i8086.json, i8086.svg, i8255.json and i8255.svg (e022b78 "parts-data: vendor the Intel 8086 support-chip faces from bw-parts", 2026-09-04; merged to master at 66d7d82 "Merge feat/i8086-ui"). The corpus gates (example-corpus-contract, expected-quantities-hold, circuit-json-roundtrip) load every examples/*/circuit*.json through this engine, and the incoming i8086-blink gallery example uses part kinds i8086 and i8255 that 14efc75 has NO data for, so its circuit cannot load at the old pin. bw-board's sibling (338ac5d) already carries the i8255/i8086 netlist side (src/i8255.js, src/i8086-adapter.js, src/i8086-extract.js), so ONLY bw-circuit-ui moves. The i8086-blink example itself is added in a SEPARATE follow-up PR, deliberately, so a red here is unambiguously the pin and a red there is unambiguously the example. The 14efc75..c276c0d range (69 commits) also carries the feat/i8086-ui reseat substitution (ed8546a, 9bff4d3, 5221490, 2044f60, 967df74, e9d9a89), the SPICE importer and honest analytical AC sweeps (ee0d108, 6154745, a05967e, 1b1bf5d), downloadable scope/sweep CSV and Circuitikz export (cbfd331, 9cc6a3f, e4046d0), and the demo-pin/seating fixes (dce2975).
